PFE.special_notes: CRITICAL: This represents Vulcan cross-sell, NOT television or TV services.

KI.special_notes: Applies strictly to Koodo broadband footprints.

naked.business_meaning: MOBILITY-ONLY customer with no bundled FFH household. This definition applies ONLY to mobility/wireless queries — see 'naked_ffh' for the reverse concept (FFH customers with no mobility).
naked.special_notes: CRITICAL disambiguation — two opposite 'naked' populations exist: (1) 'naked mobility' = mobility customer with no FFH -> TABLE bq_fda_mob_mobility_base, filter mnh_ffh_ban = 0. (2) 'naked FFH' = FFH/Home Solutions customer with no mobility -> TABLE bq_dly_dbm_customer_profl, filter mnh_mob_ban IS NULL. When the user says 'naked FFH customers' or 'naked home solutions customers', use the naked_ffh definition below, NOT this one.

database_indicators.meaning: Customer has no linked FFH household (naked mobility — mobility base only)

naked_ffh.business_meaning: FFH (Home Solutions / Fixed and Home) customer with NO linked mobility subscription — the customer has no wireless/mobile line on the account.
naked_ffh.special_notes: CRITICAL: naked FFH customers MUST be queried from bq_dly_dbm_customer_profl — NOT bq_fda_mob_mobility_base. The filter is mnh_mob_ban IS NULL (NULL = no mobility BAN linked to this FFH account). Never apply mnh_ffh_ban to this table.

database_indicators.meaning: FFH customer has no linked mobility BAN (naked FFH)

FFH.business_meaning: Fixed and Home (also called Home Solutions) — residential customers on internet, TV, home phone, or SHS products.
FFH.special_notes: When targeting FFH/Home Solutions customers, use bq_dly_dbm_customer_profl as the base table, NOT the mobility base. Key linking column to mobility: mnh_mob_ban (NULL = no linked mobility account = naked FFH).

TELUS Postpaid.definition: Telus Postpaid is just one line of business, so you should only filter for Telus Postpaid

Koodo Postpaid.definition: Koodo Postpaid is another line of business, so you should only filter for Koodo Postpaid

TELUS EPP.definition: I didn't use the term Telus EPP, but Telus EPP is a separate line of business than Telus Postpaid and Koodo Postpaid.
